name: Resolve Pending Identity to Existing User
summary: Binds a proven PendingIdentity to exactly one existing durable identity and closes the active flow bucket.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow != none and durable-identity == existing

setup: Resolve one canonical existing durable identity matching the validated proof.

postconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolved and pending-identity-flow == none and durable-identity == resolved
